name: anyweb
description: Run bounded local website tasks, check repair claims, and optionally save a website login for reuse on this computer without exposing saved secrets.

interface.shortDescription: Fill a supported Express Entry profile locally and check repairs.
interface.longDescription: Use the anyweb plugin to fill a supported Express Entry profile in visible local Chrome up to the pre-submit review, retrieve repair outcomes, save an explicitly approved website login for reuse on this computer, and Tell Jacky. It is not a general-purpose automation tool.
defaultPrompt: Fill my Express Entry profile up to the final review step on this computer.
Continue a supported website draft on this computer.
Save my website login for reuse on this computer.
Tell Jacky about an AnyWeb problem.
